question: A man spends 40% of his monthly salary on house rent. If every month, he also spends ₹442 on conveyance and ₹9,115 on grocery and saves the remaining ₹946, his monthly salary is:
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of salary spent on house rent = 40%

Monthly expenses on conveyance = ₹442

Monthly expenses on grocery = ₹9,115

Monthly savings = ₹946

**Formula Used:**

Total monthly salary = (Expenses on house rent + Expenses on conveyance + Expenses on grocery + Savings) / (Percentage of salary spent on house rent)

**Calculation:**

Let the monthly salary be ₹S.

Expenses on house rent = 40% of S = 0.4 × S

Total Expenses = ₹442 + ₹9,115 + ₹946 = ₹10,503

Total Expenses + House Rent = S

⇒ 0.4 × S + ₹10,503 = S

⇒ S - 0.4 × S = ₹10,503

⇒ 0.6 × S = ₹10,503

⇒ S = ₹10,503 / 0.6

⇒ S = ₹17,505

**The monthly salary is ₹17,505.**
